This purely local change eliminates persistent oscillations, resulting in convergence towards a stable system state. We accelerate system convergence by comparing a single boundary token to ubiquitous two-directional tokens and optimizing the deceleration factor. Event-driven simulations report convergence times and robustness: For a large variety of perturbations (such as robot deletion, position or velocity jittering), the system reliably re-converges. The results suggest a local, practical mechanism for robust load balancing for heterogeneous teams of robots that promises an effective tool as basis for more complex scenarios.

</details>


### [239] [Active sensing to characterize the heterogeneity of plant stress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27088)
*Ayman Laaroussi,Peter Hanappe,David Colliaux*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自主机器人平台，通过整合3D植物重建、几何分析和运动规划，实现对植物叶片靶向叶绿素荧光测量，从而超越传统被动成像的植物表型分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数表型平台主要依赖基于图像的测量，但先进的植物表征需要整合主动生理传感模态（如叶绿素荧光），现有系统缺乏自动化和精准定位能力。

Method: 系统利用多视角数据重建植物稠密3D模型，基于朝向、可达性和传感约束提取候选叶片表面；随后通过任务级规划框架，引导机器人末端执行器到达点式荧光采集所需的接触或近接触构型，并生成无碰撞轨迹。

Result: 平台实现了自动化、可重复、空间分辨的生理测量，超越了被动成像的限制，提供高分辨率植物表型分析能力。

Conclusion: 通过紧密耦合感知、几何推理和操作，该系统为自主农业检查和植物感知操作开辟了新方向，提供了一种机器人驱动的高分辨率植物表型分析方法。

Abstract: While most phenotyping platforms rely primarily on image-based measurements, advanced plant characterization requires the integration of active physiological sensing modali- ties such as chlorophyll fluorescence. We present an autonomous robotic platform designed to perform targeted fluorescence measurements on plant leaves. The system combines 3D plant reconstruction, geometric analysis, and motion planning to localize suitable measurement points and generate collision-free trajectories for a robotic manipulator.
  A dense 3D model of the plant is reconstructed from multi-view data and used to extract candidate leaf surfaces based on orientation, accessibility, and sensing constraints. These targets are then integrated into a task-level planning framework that guides the end-effector to precise contact or near-contact configurations required for point-based fluorescence acquisition. The platform enables automated, repeatable, and spatially resolved physiological measurements that go beyond passive imaging. By tightly coupling perception, geometric reasoning, and manipulation, the proposed system provides a robotics-driven approach to high-resolution plant phenotyping and opens new directions for autonomous agricultural inspection and plant-aware manipulation.

</details>


### [240] [Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27151)
*Haohui Pan,Takuya Kiyokawa,Kensuke Harada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化真空夹具系统，通过扩散概率模型结合贝叶斯优化，为螺丝刀和剃须刀的完整机器人拆解序列规划单一共享支撑布局，避免夹具重构，实验测得稳定裕度均值分别为66.9%和81.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则形状产品的机器人拆解中，稳定支撑面临挑战：随着组件逐步移除，支撑表面、质量分布和任务载荷持续变化，为单一工件状态设计的夹具布局在后期阶段可能不再可行，因此需要在完整拆解序列上进行统一支撑规划。

Method: 构建模块化真空夹具系统，为完整拆解序列规划一个共享支撑配置；采用去噪扩散概率模型生成物理信息启发的初始配置，再通过贝叶斯优化在混合连续-离散布局空间中进行精细化搜索，反复进行跨阶段评估。

Result: 机器人螺丝和组件移除实验验证了规划布局的拆解可行性，11项定向载荷测试量化了稳定性；实际操作载荷与定向响应对比得到平均经验稳定裕度：螺丝刀66.9%，剃须刀81.6%。

Conclusion: 产品特定的共享支撑布局能够在整个测试的机器人拆解序列中提供稳定支撑，无需夹具重构，验证了统一支撑规划策略的有效性。

Abstract: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products. As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the complete disassembly sequence of a screwdriver or shaver, allowing each sequence to proceed without fixture reconfiguration. To search the mixed continuous--discrete layout space under repeated cross-stage evaluation, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model generates physics-informed initial configurations that are refined through Bayesian optimization. Robotic screw and component-removal experiments verified the disassembly feasibility of the planned layouts, while 11 directional-load tests quantified their stability. Comparisons between the measured operational loads and directional responses yielded mean empirical stability margins of 66.9% for the screwdriver and 81.6% for the shaver. These results demonstrate that a product-specific shared layout can provide stable support throughout the tested robotic disassembly sequence.

</details>


### [241] [Task-space model-based control of pneumatic soft actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27186)
*Nithin S. Kumar,Joshua Gaston,D. Caleb Rucker,Eric J. Barth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型的实时动态模型任务空间反馈与估计框架，结合准静态前馈逆模型、任务空间PI控制器和动态观测器，在三种平面气动软体执行器上实现了1.5-2.3 mm精度的精密运动跟踪和高频周期运动控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体执行器虽能实现灵巧柔顺的交互，但因其强非线性、分布式变形和动力学不确定性，闭环任务空间控制仍面临重大挑战。

Method: 采用绝对坐标下带完整约束的非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型，通过稀疏系统矩阵保持计算效率，支持多达10个离散杆的实时控制。结合准静态前馈逆模型、任务空间PI控制器以及将测量残差融合为虚拟力的动态观测器，实现从稀疏传感中估计全状态。

Result: 在三个不同几何形状的平面气动软体执行器上完成五项任务验证，包括数字0-9绘制（尖端速度3-18 mm/s）、周期运动跟踪（最高37 cm/s）、跨平台泛化、减少传感条件和实时用户定义参考。精密运动RMSE为1.5-2.3 mm，1-2 Hz下RMSE为5.5-12.4 mm。

Conclusion: 结构化非最小动态模型能够实现平面软体气动执行器在自由空间中的实时、高精度、中等带宽任务空间控制。

Abstract: Soft actuators enable dexterous and compliant interaction, but closed-loop task-space control remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities, distributed deformation, and uncertainty in their dynamics. This paper presents a real-time dynamic-model-based task-space feedback and estimation framework based on a non-minimal coordinate discrete elastic rod model formulated in absolute coordinates with holonomic constraints. The resulting structure preserves distributed mechanics while maintaining computational efficiency through sparse system matrices, enabling real-time control with up to 10 discretized rods. A quasi-static feedforward inverse model is combined with a task-space PI controller and a dynamic observer that fuses measurement residuals as virtual forces, enabling full-state estimation from sparse sensing. The approach is experimentally validated on three planar pneumatic soft actuators with varying geometries. Across five tasks, including drawing the digits 0-9 across the workspace (3-18 mm/s tip speed), tracking periodic motion (up to 37 cm/s), cross-platform generalization, reduced sensing conditions, and real-time user-defined references, our method achieves 1.5-2.3 mm root mean square error (RMSE) for precision motions and 5.5-12.4 mm RMSE at 1-2 Hz. Results demonstrate that structured, non-minimal dynamic models can enable real-time, high-precision, moderate-bandwidth task-space control of planar soft pneumatic actuators in free space.

</details>


### [242] [Tensegrity Continuum Robots Enable Task-Adaptive Morphologies for Cooperative Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27221)
*Mahmud Hasan Saikot,Sydney Spiegel,Sudheera Akalanka Kariyawasam,Andrew Stefka,Josh Chrisler,Jianguo Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合张拉整体（tensegrity）柔性躯干与爪式连接机构的模块化可重构机器人（MRR），统一了刚性模块化机器人的自重构能力和连续体机器人的结构柔顺性，可实现多机器人自主重构为链状、环状、分支等多种形态，并完成协同操作、多模态运动和定位操作等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模块化可重构机器人（MRR）依赖刚性模块，缺乏结构柔顺性，导致环境适应能力受限；而连续体机器人虽然具备柔顺性，却无法自我重构为任务适配的多机器人构型。两类架构各自的优势无法兼得，亟需一种统一两者优势的新型机器人架构。

Method: 提出一种新型MRR架构，将基于张拉整体的柔顺躯干与基于爪子的连接机构相结合。每个机器人既能独立操作和移动，又能通过爪式连接实现多机器人自重构，形成链状、环状、分支等不同形态，以适应不同的协同操作与移动任务需求。

Result: 在多样化任务和真实场景中验证了机器人的能力，包括协同物体操作与运输、多模态运动以及定位操作（loco-manipulation），证明了该架构在实际环境中的有效性和适应性。

Conclusion: 该研究为适应性多功能机器人集群奠定了基础，在制造业、太空探索和搜救等领域具有广阔的应用前景。

Abstract: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we introduce an MRR that unifies the advantages of both architectures by combining a tensegrity-based compliant body with claw-based connection mechanisms. Each robot can manipulate and locomote independently, and multiple robots can self-reconfigure into different morphologies (e.g., chains, loops, branches) for cooperative manipulation and locomotion. We demonstrate the robots' capability across diverse tasks and environments, including coordinated object manipulation and transport, multimodal locomotion, and loco-manipulation in real-world scenarios. These results lay a foundation for adaptable and multifunctional robotic collectives, with broad potential applications in manufacturing, space exploration, and search-and-rescue operations.

</details>


### [243] [STEP: State-Aware Task Estimation and Planning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Human-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27225)
*Maitrey Gramopadhye,Prakash Baskaran,Xiao Liu,Songpo Li,Soshi Iba*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: STEP是一种状态感知的任务估计与规划方法，通过让多模态大语言模型显式估计系统状态并预测状态转移，解决工业人机协作中MM-LLM缺乏状态理解导致的动作幻觉和规划模糊问题，在机器人装配模拟任务中动作可执行性提升32.8%，最终状态误差降低14.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MM-LLM在工业人机协作任务规划中存在两个核心缺陷：一是缺乏对系统状态的显式理解，不追踪状态转移，导致生成的动机会偏离目标（幻觉动作）；二是仅生成自然语言形式的高层行动规划，缺乏执行细节，引入动作执行歧义。这些问题限制了MM-LLM在数据稀缺的工业场景中的实际应用效果。

Method: STEP（State-aware Task Estimator and Planner）方法通过提示MM-LLM显式执行两个关键步骤：1）估计系统当前状态；2）预测执行动作后系统的状态转移结果。通过将未来状态预测与动作生成联合进行，STEP不仅能保证规划的任务收敛性，还能同时输出执行预测动作所需的附加辅助参数，从而弥补自然语言高层规划的歧义性问题。

Result: 在机器人装配任务的模拟环境中，STEP相比最先进基线方法，在动作可执行性上提升32.8%，在最终状态误差上降低14.8%。

Conclusion: 通过显式引入状态感知和状态转移预测机制，STEP有效缓解了MM-LLM在长时程任务规划中的幻觉问题，同时提升了规划的可执行性和目标达成精度，为工业场景下的人机协作任务规划提供了可行的新范式。

Abstract: Effective human-robot collaboration in industrial settings requires robots to understand human intentions and assist with task planning, reducing workload. Recent works have explored the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) for task planning in such data-scarce scenarios, leveraging in-context learning to interpret user actions and generate long-horizon action plans in natural language. However, MM-LLMs inherently lack an understanding of system states and do not track state transitions, often leading to hallucinated actions that deviate from the intended goal. Additionally, generating action plans in natural language tends to limit the generated plans to a high level, introducing ambiguity in action execution. To address these limitations, we propose the State-aware Task Estimator and Planner (STEP), which prompts a MM-LLM to explicitly estimate the state of the system and predict the state transitions resulting from executed actions. By forecasting future states alongside actions, STEP ensures task-convergent planning while also providing additional assistance parameters necessary for executing the predicted actions. We evaluate STEP in a simulated environment using a robot assembly task. Our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art by 32.8% in action executability and 14.8% in final-state error.

</details>


### [244] [Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27371)
*Canzhi Chen,Zan Wang,Siqi Zhu,Qi Wu,Yixuan Li,Wei Liang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个新任务ESRP（具身场景重排规划），要求具身智能体仅依靠以自我为中心的观测和俯视目标布局，在3D场景中重排家具以匹配目标配置。论文构建了基于OmniGibson的ESRP-Bench基准（含5400+场景对和8200+物体），定义三级指标并提供了四类基线方法。实验表明现有方法难以高效完成该任务，凸显了ESRP在具身场景理解与长时程规划方面的挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重排任务允许智能体获取全局状态信息，且假设物体之间无相互遮挡，这与真实机器人部署的约束不符。作者希望设计一个更贴近实际的任务，要求智能体仅凭局部以自我为中心的观测与全局俯视布局进行对齐规划，从而推动具身智能体在真实场景中的应用。

Method: 构建ESRP任务，禁止全局状态访问并引入物体相互遮挡；基于OmniGibson搭建包含5400+场景对和8200+物体的ESRP-Bench基准；设计三个多级别指标评估重排质量；提供四类基线方法，包括层级任务与运动规划方法、基于视觉语言模型的方法、以及模仿学习和强化学习两种学习方法。

Result: 实验结果显示现有各类基线方法均难以高效完成ESRP任务，表明该任务对当前具身智能体在场景理解与长时程规划方面构成显著挑战。

Conclusion: ESRP作为具身AI的新兴前沿任务具有很高的挑战性，其基准和基线为后续研究提供了基础参考，是推动智能体向真实世界部署迈进的垫脚石。

Abstract: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a novel task requiring embodied agents to rearrange furniture in 3D scenes to match a target configuration using only egocentric observations and a top-down target layout. Unlike prior rearrangement tasks, ESRP precludes global state access and introduces mutual object occlusions, reflecting the practical constraints of real-world robotic deployment. These factors make aligning partial egocentric observations with the global target layout particularly challenging for long-horizon planning. To facilitate research, we present ESRP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built on OmniGibson featuring over 5,400 scene pairs and 8,200 objects. We define three multi-level metrics to evaluate rearrangement quality and provide four baselines: a hierarchical task-and-motion planning method, a vision-language-model-based method, and two learning-based approaches (IL and RL). Experimental results demonstrate that current methods struggle to complete the task efficiently, highlighting ESRP as a challenging frontier for embodied agents in scene understanding and long-horizon task planning. This work serves as a stepping stone toward deploying intelligent agents in real-world scenarios. Project page: https://pie-lab.cn/ESRP/.

</details>


### [245] [FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27384)
*Zekai Li,Jiaming Tang,Zhijian Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlashVLA是一个流式动作解码框架，通过维护多噪声级别的流式动作缓冲区并采用分块因果注意力，在每个推理步骤生成一个可执行动作块，在保证任务性能的同时将控制频率提升至单GPU上≥30Hz，并实现平滑的异步执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中表现优异，但其实际部署受限于高推理延迟和不稳定的异步执行。尤其对于基于流匹配的VLA模型，动作解码需要多个迭代步骤，现有方法难以同时实现低延迟推理和准确、时间一致的异步执行。

Method: FlashVLA提出统一的流式动作解码框架：维护包含多个不同噪声级别块（chunk）的流式动作缓冲区，使用分块因果注意力（chunk-wise causal attention）进行解码，每个推理步骤产生一个可执行的动作块。其分块自回归（chunk-wise autoregressive）设计隐式保持了动作连续性，无需额外的未来状态条件即可实现平滑的异步执行。

Result: 在大量仿真和真实世界实验中，FlashVLA显著提升了推理速度，同时保持了强大的任务性能。在单个GPU上可实现≥30Hz的控制频率，并在实际部署中实现平滑的异步推理。

Conclusion: FlashVLA通过统一框架同时解决了低延迟推理和稳定异步执行两大挑战，为流匹配类VLA模型的高效实时部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly promising for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment remains bottlenecked by high inference latency and unstable asynchronous execution. This challenge is particularly pronounced in flow-matching-based VLA models, where action decoding requires multiple iterative steps conditioned on the VLM context. While efficient inference methods improve control frequency and asynchronous methods reduce execution idle time, existing approaches often fail to jointly achieve low-latency inference and accurate, temporally consistent asynchronous execution. We introduce \textbf{FlashVLA}, a streaming action decoding framework that addresses both challenges in a unified formulation. FlashVLA maintains a streaming action buffer with multiple chunks at different noise levels and decodes them using chunk-wise causal attention. This design allows FlashVLA to produce one executable action chunk per inference step. Moreover, its chunk-wise autoregressive formulation implicitly preserves action continuity, enabling smooth asynchronous execution without extra future-state conditioning. Across extensive simulated and real-world experiments, FlashVLA substantially improves inference speed while maintaining strong task performance. It can achieve $\geq$30\,Hz control frequency on a single GPU with smooth asynchronous inference in real-world deployment.

</details>


### [246] [CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27406)
*Kechen Liu,Ola Shorinwa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CLAP是一个跨embodiment的动作条件视频生成框架，能够利用互联网规模的多源异构视频数据（涵盖人类和机器人）进行训练，通过学习通用物理先验并采用课程式跨embodiment训练策略，在多个机器人平台上达到或超越单embodiment最先进模型的性能，并提供零样本部署和少样本自适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最先进的动作条件视频模型通常局限于单一机器人embodiment，无法利用包含丰富物理学习信号的多样化异构视频数据。此外，不同机器人平台间的动作表示差异巨大，且人类视频中通常缺乏动作标注，这阻碍了跨embodiment的通用物理规律学习。

Method: CLAP通过三个核心贡献解决上述挑战：(1) 使用端到端位姿（end-effector poses）、语言指令和潜在动作（latent actions）来统一不同动作空间；(2) 引入基于课程学习的跨embodiment训练策略，先在未标注视频数据上用潜在动作学习基础物理先验，再在端到端位姿动作空间中落地这些先验，实现零样本部署；(3) 通过少样本自适应进一步积累性能优势。

Result: CLAP在DROID等具挑战性环境中达到或超越单embodiment最先进的视频模型性能，并通过少样本自适应进一步放大这种优势。框架覆盖多种动作条件空间（端到端位姿、语言、潜在动作）和多种机器人形态（跨embodiment、DROID、Bridge、双臂YAM机器人、G1人形机器人），是迄今最全面的动作条件视频世界模型套件。

Conclusion: CLAP证明了跨embodiment的动作条件视频生成是可行且有效的，建立了训练单embodiment视频世界模型的新范式，并开源了所有代码和模型，推动了通用物理推理视频模型的进展。

Abstract: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [247] [EduRiskX: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework with F-Logic Reasoning for Early Academic Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26107)
*Yu Fu,Yongqi Kang,Yong Zhao,Rongfang Bie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EduRiskX，一个融合时间Transformer预测器与F-Logic符号推理的神经符号框架，用于在线教育中学生学业风险的早期检测与可解释预测。在OULAD数据集上达到0.900准确率和0.894 F1分数，平均早期检测周数为9.32周，检测率94.30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线教育学业风险预测模型存在两大缺陷：早期检测能力有限（往往发现问题时为时已晚），以及"黑盒"特性导致可解释性不足，这引发信任危机并阻碍模型在实际教学场景中的落地应用。

Method: 提出EduRiskX框架，包含两部分：1) 神经组件：基于时间Transformer的预测器，利用时间注意力建模纵向学生活动序列，结合类加权损失和动态周截断技术；2) 符号组件：基于F-Logic的规则库，以Engagement Theory（参与理论）和Student Integration Model（学生整合模型）为基础，纯从训练数据构建，模拟教育者的诊断逻辑；3) 融合机制：通过逻辑回归将神经风险概率与符号置信度分数融合，学习两信号的相对贡献。

Result: 在OULAD数据集上采用严格的80/10/10学生级划分。学期结束（第38周）时达到0.900准确率和0.894 F1分数，平均早期检测周数9.32周，检测率94.30%。与SOTA时序模型（PatchTST、iTransformer）及常见深度学习基线（LSTM、CNN）相比，在相同条件下取得了更高的召回率和更早的风险识别。

Conclusion: EduRiskX不仅实现了更优的预测性能，其F-Logic模块还能提供结构化的基于规则的解释，将预测结果与可观察的行为模式及教育理论联系起来，在预测准确性与可解释性之间取得了平衡，增强了模型在实际教务场景中的可信度和可采纳性。

Abstract: Predicting students' academic risk in online education is crucial for enabling timely interventions that can improve retention and learning outcomes. However, existing models often suffer from limited early detection capability and insufficient interpretability, leading to a "black-box" trust crisis that hinders their adoption in real-world pedagogical settings. To address these challenges, we propose EduRiskX, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates a temporal Transformer-based predictor with F-Logic symbolic reasoning. The neural component models longitudinal student activity sequences using temporal attention, class-weighted loss, and dynamic weekly truncation. Acting as a data-driven expert system, an F-Logic rule base -- grounded in established educational theories (Engagement Theory and Student Integration Model) to mimic the diagnostic logic of human educators -- is constructed exclusively from the training data. The neural risk probability and the symbolic confidence score are then combined through a logistic regression-based fusion mechanism that learns the relative contribution of each signal. Experiments on the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) using a strict 80/10/10 student-level split show that EduRiskX achieves an accuracy of 0.900 and an F1-score of 0.894 at the end of the semester (Week 38), with an average early detection week of 9.32 and a detection rate of 94.30 percent. Compared with state-of-the-art time-series models (PatchTST, iTransformer) and common deep learning baselines (LSTM, CNN), EduRiskX yields improved recall and earlier risk identification under identical conditions. Beyond predictive performance, the F-Logic module provides structured rule-based explanations linking predictions to observable behavioral patterns and educational theories.

</details>


### [248] [Standalone LLM and a Pre-specified Agentic Pipeline for Explaining ICU Mortality Predictions: a Feasibility Study on the eICU Demo Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26109)
*Di Zhu,Chen Xie,Haoyun Zhang,Zihan Wei,Ziwei Wang,Jiazhao Shi,Ziyu Wang,Qiyang Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究比较了独立LLM与四步agentic流水线在ICU死亡风险解释生成中的表现。XGBoost模型在2,353例ICU住院中取得AUROC 0.855、AUPRC 0.332；在38例解释子集上，独立LLM出现1例显式结果泄露，agentic流水线为0例。两者在SHAP对齐、方向一致性上独立LLM更优，但agentic流水线在指南依据、数值特异性和临床合理性上更优。研究建议agentic分解可提升安全相关的依据生成，但需配合基于归因的检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型能准确预测ICU死亡率，但传统的特征归因方法难以提供临床叙事以支持床旁使用。大语言模型有望弥合这一差距，而多步agentic流水线通过分离数据解释、指南核查和最终解释，是合理的扩展方向。本研究旨在保留独立与agentic对比的同时，使主要临床发现更加明确。

Method: 在保留的本地eICU Demo数据集（2,353例ICU住院，8.1%死亡率）上训练XGBoost模型（AUROC 0.855，AUPRC 0.332）。在分层抽取的38例解释子集上，对比独立LLM与四步agentic流水线的解释质量，评估维度包括结果泄露、SHAP对齐（Jaccard系数）、方向一致性、指南依据、数值特异性和临床合理性。

Result: 独立LLM产生1例显式结果泄露，agentic流水线为0例。在14例与SHAP审查子集重叠的病例中，独立LLM的SHAP对齐更高（Jaccard 0.171 vs 0.077）、方向一致性更高（92.9% vs 78.6%）；agentic流水线的指南依据更高（0.762 vs 0.143）、数值特异性更高（0.236 vs 0.143）、临床合理性略高（0.700 vs 0.671）。

Conclusion: agentic分解可能改善安全相关的依据生成和患者特异性细节，但应配合基于归因的检查后再用于高风险场景的风险解释。两种方法各有优势，需要结合使用以兼顾对齐性与临床上合理的解释。

Abstract: Machine-learning models can predict ICU mortality accurately, but feature-attribution methods alone rarely provide the clinical narrative needed for bedside use. Large language models (LLMs) may bridge this gap, and multi-step agentic pipelines are a plausible extension because they separate data interpretation, guideline checking, and final explanation. This revised feasibility study preserves the original standalone-versus-agentic comparison while making the main clinical findings more explicit. Using the retained local eICU Demo artifact set (2,353 ICU stays; 8.1\% mortality), XGBoost achieved an AUROC of 0.855 (95\% CI 0.796--0.906) and an AUPRC of 0.332 (95\% CI 0.217--0.494). On a stratified 38-case explanation subset, the standalone LLM produced 1 explanation with explicit outcome leakage, whereas the four-step agentic pipeline produced none. Among the 14 cases that overlapped with the SHAP review subset, the standalone LLM showed higher SHAP alignment (mean Jaccard 0.171 versus 0.077) and higher direction consistency (92.9\% versus 78.6\%), while the agentic pipeline showed higher guideline grounding (0.762 versus 0.143), higher value specificity (0.236 versus 0.143), and slightly higher plausibility (0.700 versus 0.671). Clinically, the results suggest that agentic decomposition may improve safety-relevant grounding and patient-specific detail, but it should be paired with attribution-based checks before use in high-stakes risk explanation.

</details>


### [249] [Large Models for Battery Prognostics and Health Management: A Review and Future Roadmap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26111)
*Jiale Liu,Huan Wang,Weicheng Wang,Rong Zhu,Qiqi Wang,Min Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是首个关于大型模型（LMs）在电池预测与健康管理（BPHM）中应用的系统综述，探讨了基于Transformer和自监督预训练的大模型如何应对传统BPHM方法在计算效率、跨域泛化、标签数据依赖和可解释性等方面的瓶颈，并提出了未来研究路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BPHM方法（基于物理模型和面向任务的深度学习）在计算效率、参数化、跨域泛化能力、对大量标注run-to-failure数据依赖以及模型可解释性方面存在长期瓶颈。大型模型基于Transformer架构和自监督预训练，提供了一种变革性新范式来克服这些挑战。

Method: 本文首先阐述支撑大模型的基础技术（Transformer架构、自监督学习、大规模多模态数据集和PEFT技术），然后从四个关键维度对最新进展进行分类综述：缓解数据稀缺、增强泛化与鲁棒性、集成领域知识以实现可解释性、以及实现系统级自动化。

Result: 综述展示了大型模型在BPHM各维度上的已有成果，同时指出数据可访问性、智能验证、可信度和部署可行性方面仍存在重大挑战。该综述建立了系统化的框架来理解和推进大模型驱动的BPHM。

Conclusion: 未来研究应聚焦于构建协作数据生态系统、验证工业应用智能、通过物理信息设计增强可信度以及实现高效的端侧部署，从而开发安全、可靠、自主运行的下一代电池管理系统。

Abstract: Battery Prognostics and Health Management (BPHM) is critical for ensuring the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of batteries across electric vehicles, grid storage, and consumer electronics. Conventional BPHM approaches, including physics-based models and task-centric deep learning methods, face challenges in computational efficiency and parameterization, cross-domain generalization, dependence on extensive labeled run-to-failure data, and model interpretability. Recent Large Models (LMs), built upon Transformer architectures and self-supervised pre-training, offer a transformative new paradigm to overcome these long-standing bottlenecks. This review provides the first comprehensive survey of LM applications in BPHM, systematically examining how these models address challenges in the field. We begin by elucidating the foundational technologies enabling LMs, including Transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, large-scale multimodal datasets, and PEFT techniques. We then categorize recent progress along four critical dimensions: mitigating data scarcity, enhancing generalization and robustness, integrating domain knowledge for interpretability, and enabling system-level automation. Despite promising results, significant challenges remain across data accessibility, intelligence validation, trustworthiness, and deployment feasibility. To guide future research, we propose a roadmap focused on building collaborative data ecosystems, validating intelligence for industrial applications, enhancing trustworthiness with physics-informed designs, and enabling efficient on-device deployment. This review establishes a systematic approach to understand and advance LM-driven BPHM, providing researchers and practitioners with essential insights for developing next-generation battery management systems capable of safe, reliable, and autonomous operation throughout battery lifecycles.

</details>


### [250] [PICasso: An AI-Enabled Design Framework for Autonomous Optimization of Silicon Photonic Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26113)
*Deepak Vungarala,Deniz Najafi,Abdulrahman Aljoudi,Zahra Ghanaatian,Navid Khoshavi,Gourav Datta,Arman Roohi,Mahdi Nikdast,Shaahin Angizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PICasso框架，将自然语言规格自动转化为可制造的光子集成电路（PIC）版图，通过结构化的NL→YAML→GDS流水线、PDK感知、自动布局布线、DRC/LVS验证和SAX仿真优化，并结合PIC-Set基准（36个参数化PIC设计任务）系统评估多种LLM。实验表明PICasso显著提升规格满足率（结构性Spec@3达92.7%，功能性达52%），并将平均插入损耗从4.98dB降至3.25dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子集成电路设计高度依赖专家知识且流程复杂，现有LLM直接生成版图缺乏物理可制造性和设计规则约束，容易出现不可制造的、规格不满足的结果。作者旨在将LLM从脆弱的网表生成器转变为实用的PIC设计智能体，实现从自然语言到可制造版图的端到端自动化。

Method: PICasso采用三层核心策略：(1) 结构化NL→YAML→GDS生成流水线，引入PDK感知知识注入、自动布局布线和DRC/LVS验证；(2) 基于SAX的光子仿真用于功能验证和优化；(3) 构建PIC-Set基准（36个参数化任务），引入结构性和功能性Spec@k、优化效率和鲁棒性等新评估指标，对多种SOTA LLM进行统一评测。

Result: 在PIC-Set基准上，PICasso相对vanilla LLM生成显著提升端到端规格满足率：结构性Spec@3最高达92.7%，功能性Spec@3在高复杂度电路上达52%。通过仿真引导优化，平均插入损耗从4.98dB降至3.25dB（改善1.74dB），且运行时间与手动GUI流程相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 结构化领域约束、物理验证和仿真反馈三者结合，能够将LLM转变为实用的PIC设计智能体，使其具备生成可制造版图的能力。这为AI驱动的光子设计自动化奠定了基准和框架基础，展示了在复杂工程领域中结合领域知识与大模型的可行路径。

Abstract: We present PICasso, an AI-assisted framework for automated synthesis, verification, and optimization of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) from natural-language specifications. PICasso couples a structured NL -> YAML -> GDS generation pipeline with PDK aware knowledge injection, automated placement and routing, DRC/LVS validation, and SAX-based photonic simulation. To systematically evaluate AI-driven photonic design, we introduce PIC-Set, a benchmark of 36 parameterized PIC design tasks spanning core photonic primitives and multi-component circuits. Using PIC-Set, we benchmark several state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) under a unified evaluation protocol, including new metrics such as structural and functional $Spec@k$, optimization efficiency, and robustness under perturbations. Across the benchmark, PICasso significantly improves end-to-end specification satisfaction compared to vanilla LLM generation. Structural $Spec@3$ reaches up to 92.7% and functional $Spec@3$ up to 52% on high-complexity circuits. In addition, PICasso consistently reduces circuit insertion loss, lowering the mean loss from 4.98 dB to 3.25 dB (1.74 dB improvement) through simulation-guided optimization. These results demonstrate that structured domain constraints, physical verification, and simulation feedback transform LLMs from brittle netlist generators into practical PIC design agents capable of producing manufacturable layouts with competitive runtimes relative to manual GUI-based workflows.

</details>


### [251] [CIFQA: A Deterministic Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Financial Query Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26114)
*Kunjesh Parekh,Anil Kumar Tiwari,Divya Saxena*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CIFQA，一个基于工具的多智能体LLM框架，通过将语言理解与数值执行分离来提升计算密集型金融问答的准确性。在定期存款查询基准上达到90.87%的总体准确率，远超直接LLM基线，并证明架构设计比模型规模对数值可靠性更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算密集型金融问答需要对结构化利率、时间条件和数值公式进行精确推理，而LLM即使在这些任务上表现良好，也常产生数值错误但看似合理的答案。直接使用LLM求解多步金融计算存在根本性的准确性问题，需要一种分离语言理解与数值执行的解决方案。

Method: CIFQA采用多智能体架构，分配专门智能体分别负责查询解释、路由、参数提取、计算规划和响应生成，同时使用确定性Python工具执行金融计算和规则应用。该方法将LLM的语义理解能力与Python工具的精确计算能力相结合。

Result: 在定期存款查询基准上，CIFQA在计算密集型查询上达到95.54%的准确率，总体准确率90.87%，显著优于直接LLM基线。消融研究表明确定性组件（精确利率查找、期限计算、滚动年度调整和提前支取逻辑）是性能的关键贡献者。使用17B开源模型作为骨干的CIFQA甚至优于提供相同金融信息的更大规模前沿模型。

Conclusion: CIFQA展示了架构设计（工具落地、多智能体分工）比模型规模更能决定金融数值推理的可靠性，并且该框架虽在定期存款场景验证，但可推广至更广泛的计算密集型金融推理任务。

Abstract: Calculation-intensive financial question answering requires exact reasoning over structured rates, temporal conditions, numerical formulas, and rule-based constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on natural language tasks, they often produce numerically incorrect yet plausible answers when solving multi-step financial calculations. To address this limitation, we introduce CIFQA (Calculation-Intensive Financial Query Answering), a deterministic tool-grounded multi-agent LLM framework for financial question answering. CIFQA separates language understanding from numerical execution by assigning specialized agents to query interpretation, routing, parameter extraction, computation planning, and response generation, while deterministic Python-based tools perform financial calculations and rule application. We instantiate CIFQA for fixed deposit query answering and evaluate it on a curated benchmark of fixed deposit queries. CIFQA achieves 95.54% accuracy on calculation-intensive queries and 90.87% overall accuracy, substantially outperforming direct LLM baselines even when provided with complete formulas, rate cards, and benchmark instructions. Ablation studies show that deterministic components such as exact rate lookup, tenure computation, rolling-year adjustment, and premature-withdrawal logic are critical contributors to performance. Notably, a 17B open-source backbone operating within CIFQA outperforms substantially larger frontier models evaluated with the same financial information, demonstrating that architectural design is a more important determinant of numerical reliability than model scale. While evaluated on fixed deposit queries, CIFQA provides a generalizable framework for calculation-intensive financial reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [252] [The Artificial Experimentalist: Discovery and Control of Self-Organizing Phenomena with Autotelic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26116)
*Marko Cvjetko,Benedikt Hartl,Michael Levin,Clément Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于自生成目标强化学习（autotelic RL）的闭环框架，用于在复杂系统中通过最小局部扰动进行干预和控制。在该框架下构建的智能体系统CARL能在Lenia（连续元胞自动机）中自主发现稳定孤立子、学习控制其运动方向，并能将人类高层指令转化为低层干预，实现对涌现现象的发现与控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探索元胞自动机等复杂系统的方法多为开环模式：设置初始条件、运行完整模拟、观察结果，无法在执行过程中进行干预。这种局限性阻碍了对涌现现象的有效发现和控制，需要一种闭环的自主动态干预方法。

Method: 提出基于自生成目标强化学习（autotelic RL）的闭环框架：智能体自主采样多样目标并学习目标条件策略，通过最小局部扰动干预复杂系统。在Lenia上实例化为CARL系统，训练覆盖多目标、多种更新规则和随机初始状态。

Result: CARL在广泛的Lenia更新规则下以高于启发式基线的方法发现稳定孤立子；能通过少量干预学习控制已有孤立子的运动方向；人类可通过高层方向指令实时引导孤立子穿越迷宫环境。训练后的智能体策略能零样本泛化到各种分布外条件。

Conclusion: 结果表明，自生成目标强化学习为自主或人类引导下发现和控制复杂系统中的涌现现象提供了一条可行路径，并预示着人工实验者智能体的可能性。

Abstract: Existing methods for exploring cellular automata and other complex systems mostly operate in open loop: they set initial conditions, execute a full simulation, and observe the outcome, without intervening during execution. We introduce a closed-loop framework based on autotelic reinforcement learning, in which an agent autonomously samples diverse goals and learns a goal-conditioned policy to intervene in a complex system through minimal, local perturbations. We instantiate this framework on Lenia, a continuous cellular automaton known for life-like self-organizing patterns, in an agentic system we call CARL, and demonstrate three capabilities. First, CARL discovers stable solitons across a wide range of Lenia update rules at a higher rate than heuristic baselines. Second, it learns to steer the movement direction of existing solitons with few interventions, showing that CARL can control self-organizing patterns, not only create them. Third, humans can use trained agents to guide solitons through maze environments in real time by specifying high-level directional commands that the agent translates into low-level interventions. Trained across diverse goals, update rules, and random initial states, the agents acquire policies that generalize zero-shot to various out-of-distribution conditions. These results suggest a path toward artificial experimentalist agents that, autonomously or with human guidance, discover and control emergent phenomena in complex systems.

</details>


### [253] [The Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox Quantifying Net Energy Loss in on-Device Energy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26134)
*Jaeik Jeong,Tai-Yeon Ku,Wan-Ki Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了能源预测中的"精度-效率悖论"：高精度能源预测模型可能因边缘AI推理能耗和电池老化导致净能源赤字。作者提出TCO框架，将推理能耗与电池老化统一视为能源损失，证明在热敏感边缘环境中，复杂架构的高精度优势往往被其高运行强度带来的总能源损耗所抵消。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源预测旨在最大化精度以减少能源浪费，但在边缘AI环境下，高精度模型的推理能耗和电池老化可能反而导致净能源损失，此前缺乏统一考量这些因素的分析框架。

Method: 提出总拥有成本（TCO）框架，将推理能耗和电池老化统一建模为能量损失形式，在热敏感边缘环境中分析不同复杂度的预测架构的净能源收益。

Result: 在热敏感的边缘环境中，复杂架构因精度提升节省的能源往往小于其高运行强度导致的总能源损失，验证了精度-效率悖论的成立。

Conclusion: 能源预测模型的选择不应仅以预测精度为准则，而应以净能源损失最小化为目标，TCO框架为此提供了统一的评估与优化方法。

Abstract: Energy forecasting aims to maximize accuracy to ensure energy efficiency by reducing energy waste, an objective that applies equally to on-device forecasting for mission-critical edge environments, including military systems. However, this paper identifies the Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox: high-precision energy forecasting models can ironically trigger a net energy deficit. This stems from both edge AI's inference energy consumption and battery aging. We propose a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) framework for energy forecasting, designed to minimize net energy loss. This framework treats not only inference energy consumption but also battery aging as a unified form of energy loss, as degradation represents a physical dissipation of the system's future energy-carrying capacity. We demonstrate that in thermally sensitive edge environments, energy saved by the superior precision of complex architectures is often outweighed by the total energy lost through their high operational intensity.

</details>


### [254] [LLMs for Academic Workflows: An Evaluation of Literature Reviews Generated with Short and Long Context Windows of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26145)
*Muhammad Ali Chaudhry,Xinyuan Hao,Haifa Alwahaby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了大语言模型在短上下文和长上下文设置下生成的文献综述质量，发现AI生成的综述需要人类监督才能达到学术出版标准，长上下文虽能整合更多信息但会加剧内容重复、遗漏关键工作和描述性过强等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究上下文窗口对AI生成文献综述质量的影响，以及AI在辅助文献综述写作中的作用和局限。

Method: 基于Semantic Scholar和Arxiv的研究来源生成20篇AI文献综述，由两名研究人员在15个维度上进行评估，比较短上下文和长上下文设置下的生成质量。

Result: AI生成的文献综述需要人类监督才能达到学术出版标准；增加上下文窗口可使LLM整合更广泛的信息并维持长输入的一致性，但同时会加剧内容重复、遗漏关键工作以及重描述轻综合的问题。

Conclusion: AI生成的文献综述可作为基础性概述，但必须由领域专家进行批判性评估和精细化修改；未来研究应考虑整合其他LLM和跨领域微调模型，采用人类专业知识与AI能力结合的混合方法来解决已识别的局限。

Abstract: Our research focuses on evaluating literature reviews generated in short and long context settings of large language models (LLMs) to investigate the impact of context window on the quality of AI-generated literature reviews and the role of AI in supporting literature review writing. Twenty AI-generated literature reviews based on research sources from Semantic Scholar and Arxiv were evaluated by two researchers across 15 dimensions. Our findings reveal that AI-generated literature reviews require human oversight to meet academic publishing standards. As context windows increase, LLMs can incorporate broader information and maintain coherence across longer inputs, but they also exacerbate issues such as content repetition, omission of critical work, and a tendency towards descriptiveness over synthesis. Our work shows that AI-generated reviews can provide foundational overviews, but their output must be critically evaluated and refined by domain experts. Future research should consider integrating other LLMs and fine-tuned models in different domains with hybrid approaches that combine human expertise with AI capabilities to address the limitations identified in this study.

</details>


### [255] [Methodological and Conceptual Framework for 5D Multi-Table Analysis: A Unified Approach for Complex Data Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26149)
*Edouard Lansiaux,Hugo Kazzi,Aurélien Loison,Slim Hammadi,Emmanuel Chazard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出关系超图Transformer（RHT），一种将关系数据库表示为超图、学习五维嵌入（PentE）并执行稀疏关系注意力的统一架构，用于医疗等多表学习场景，复杂度与平均关系度成正比而非实体数的平方。在Synthea合成电子健康记录数据集上，RHT在嵌入语义一致性方面优于表格、关系和时间图基线，同时保持计算可扩展性，XGBoost在稀有代码召回率上最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多表学习是医疗等复杂信息系统中的核心挑战，涉及数据量大、高维变量、高基数列别特征、复杂跨表依赖和重复时间观测等多种复杂性来源。现有方法难以同时处理这些挑战，亟需一种统一且可扩展的架构。

Method: RHT将关系数据库建模为超图，通过PentE（五维嵌入）学习实体表示，并设计稀疏关系注意力机制，其计算复杂度与平均关系度成线性关系而非与实体数平方相关。提供了形式化架构定义、注意力复杂度推导及开源参考实现。

Result: 在Synthea数据集上以SNOMED CT条件码的多标签预测为任务进行基准测试，RHT在嵌入语义一致性上超越表格、关系和时间图基线，同时保持计算可扩展性；XGBoost取得最高的稀有代码召回率。消融研究量化了各架构组件的贡献。

Conclusion: RHT展示了在复杂关系医疗数据上兼顾语义表示质量和计算可扩展性的潜力，但稀有类别预测上仍弱于传统梯度提升方法；计划通过PhysioNet认证后在MIMIC-IV上进行临床验证。

Abstract: Multi-table learning remains a major challenge in machine learning for healthcare and other complex information systems. Relational data combine several sources of complexity, including large data volume, high-dimensional variables, high-cardinality categorical features, complex inter-table dependencies, and repeated temporal observations. We introduce the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs, learns pentadimensional embeddings (PentE), and performs sparse relational attention with complexity proportional to the average relational degree rather than the square of the number of entities. We formally define the architecture, derive the complexity of its attention mechanism, and provide an open-source reference implementation. We evaluate RHT on the public Synthea synthetic electronic health record dataset using multi-label prediction of SNOMED CT condition codes per encounter, a task characterized by high categorical cardinality and long-tailed label distributions. Comparisons with tabular, relational, and temporal graph baselines show that RHT produces more semantically coherent embeddings while remaining computationally scalable. In this benchmark, the highest rare-code recall is achieved by XGBoost, whereas RHT attains the strongest embedding semantic coherence. We also report ablation studies quantifying the contribution of each architectural component. Clinical validation on MIMIC-IV is planned following PhysioNet credentialing. Source code and experimental protocols are provided in the accompanying repository.

</details>


### [256] [Leveraging Large Language Models for Systematic Literature Review of Disease Spread Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26150)
*Orhan Yagizer Cinar,Timur Emre Ozkose,Emma Von Hoene,Amira Roess,Taylor Anderson,Hamdi Kavak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个LLM流水线，用于从536篇基于代理建模（ABM）论文中自动提取模型相关信息，并与人工系统文献综述（SLR）结果对比。GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0的论文级准确率分别约为77.95%和81.67%，字段级准确率在32.40%到100%之间波动，复杂或主观字段可靠性较低。研究发现LLM间的一致性可作为输出质量的潜在指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的进步为自动化系统文献综述提供了新机遇，但缺乏系统性评估LLM在此任务上的实际表现与局限性。需要实证研究LLM流水线能否有效替代或辅助人工SLR。

Method: 开发了一个LLM流水线用于从536篇同行评审的基于代理建模论文中提取模型相关信息，并将结果与人工进行的SLR结果进行对比。评估了GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0两种模型的论文级和字段级准确率，并分析了LLM间一致性作为质量指标的价值。

Result: GPT-4.1论文级准确率约77.95%，GPT-5.0约81.67%；字段级准确率范围从32.40%到100.00%，复杂或主观性较强的字段表现较差。LLM间低一致性可能预示幻觉，高一致性但低准确率可能指向人类数据集中的噪声或错误。

Conclusion: 研究为提示词开发提供了实践见解，并指出了LLM在建模与仿真领域大规模SLR中的潜力与局限——LLM可行但尚不能完全替代人工，一致性分析有助于质量诊断。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have created new opportunities to streamline and potentially automate many research processes, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). This study reports an LLM pipeline development for extracting model-relevant information from 536 peer-reviewed agent-based modeling papers. We compare the results with those of a human-conducted SLR. Our results show paper-level accuracies of approximately 77.95% for GPT-4.1 and 81.67% for GPT-5.0. Field-level accuracy ranges from 32.40% to 100.00%, with more complex or subjective fields performing less reliably. Importantly, we find that agreement between LLMs is a potential indicator of output quality: low agreement may signal hallucinations, whereas high agreement combined with low accuracy may point to noise or errors in the human dataset. Overall, our study provides practical insights into prompt development and highlights both the potential and limitations of using LLMs for full-scale SLRs in the modeling and simulation domain.

</details>


### [257] [Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26151)
*Sandeep Gaddamwar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对电信客户流失预测中"高精度模型不可解释、难以落地CRM"的痛点，在IBM Telco Churn基准上对比了四种分类器（LR、RF、XGBoost、LightGBM），发现模型性能几乎持平（AUC均在0.831-0.841之间），LR略优AUC（0.8411），LightGBM准确率最高（78.42%）；同时提供全局和实例级SHAP/LIME解释，并提出四层CRM集成架构，预测可将整体流失率降低3.3-5.3个百分点，每轮营销周期可保留约199K-319K美元收入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能的集成树模型和非线性架构因缺乏可解释性而无法被一线客服人员直接使用——仅凭流失概率分数无法设计个性化干预方案。本文旨在弥合预测模型与CRM工作流之间的鸿沟，使高精度模型输出的风险分数和归因信息能被实际落地。

Method: 在IBM Telco Customer Churn数据集（7,043条记录、19个特征、训练集经SMOTE平衡至50%）上对比了四种分类器，计算AUC-ROC和准确率并进行5折交叉验证；通过全局SHAP排名识别主导流失信号，使用实例级SHAP和LIME分解解释单条预测；最后设计四层CRM集成架构，将风险分数和归因向量转化为分层客户细分、将关键特征映射为结构化挽留动作模板，并将活动结果回馈到再训练循环中。

Result: Logistic Regression获得最佳AUC-ROC（0.8411），LightGBM获得最高准确率（78.42%），四种模型AUC差距仅0.011（0.831-0.841），5折交叉验证显示领先模型实质上无显著差异。全局SHAP显示订阅时长（tenure）、总费用（total charges）和按月合约（month-to-month contract）是最主要的流失信号。针对最高风险五分位客户进行干预，预计可将整体流失率降低3.3-5.3个百分点，每个活动周期可保留约199K-319K美元。

Conclusion: 本文表明，在流失预测任务中，可解释的Logistic Regression与复杂集成模型在性能上几乎持平，可解释性与预测能力并非不可兼得；通过SHAP/LIME解释与四层CRM架构的结合，可为一线留存人员提供可操作的个体级洞察，实现从"预测分数"到"可执行挽留行动"的端到端闭环。

Abstract: Subscriber attrition is a costly, persistent challenge for telecommunications providers, with monthly churn of roughly 1.9% in mature markets eroding billions in revenue annually. Predictive models can flag at-risk customers accurately, yet they are routinely excluded from frontline CRM workflows because high-performing ensemble and non-linear architectures are opaque: a retention specialist cannot design a personalised intervention from a probability score alone, without knowing why a subscriber is at risk. This paper addresses that gap. We benchmark four classifiers--Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM--on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (7,043 records; 19 features; 26.5% churn, balanced to 50% via SMOTE on the training partition only). Logistic Regression attains the strongest AUC-ROC (0.8411) and LightGBM the highest accuracy (78.42%); all four fall within a 0.011 AUC band (0.831--0.841), and 5-fold cross-validation confirms the leading models are effectively tied. Explanations are delivered at two granularities: a global SHAP ranking identifying tenure, total charges, and month-to-month contract as the dominant churn signals, and instance-level SHAP and LIME decompositions that expose the drivers behind each prediction. Building on these outputs, we introduce a four-layer CRM integration architecture that converts risk scores and attribution vectors into tiered segmentation, maps top features to structured retention-action templates, and routes campaign outcomes into a retraining feedback loop. Targeting the highest-risk quintile is projected to cut overall churn by 3.3--5.3 percentage points, preserving an estimated $199K--$319K per campaign cycle.

</details>


### [258] [EEG-to-Report: An Annotation and Feature-Text Framework for Training Language Models on Clinical EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26153)
*Xuan-The Tran,Le Trung Kien Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了EEG-to-Report，一个基于浏览器的EEG标注与特征-文本框架，将常规EEG审阅与AI就绪数据集构建相结合，支持多格式数据摄入、交互式查看、多模态标注（文本+语音）、自动特征提取以及基于CNN集成和LLM的自动报告生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床EEG报告仍主要依赖人工且耗时，现有EEG软件生态无法生成训练现代语言模型所需的结构化EEG-文本监督信号，大多数工具仅支持可视化或预处理，缺乏对AI高质量数据集构建工作流的支持。

Method: EEG-to-Report框架包含：1) 多格式EEG数据摄入与通道标准化；2) 交互式查看器与多模态标注层（结合打字文本与转录音声笔记）；3) 特征提取引擎，计算频谱、时域、熵、Hjorth、连通性和尖波相关描述符，并以便携JSON模式存储；4) 自动报告模块，结合卷积网络集成与大型语言模型生成临床叙述草稿供神经科医生审阅。

Result: 通过试点标注，该框架简化了标注工作流并生成可编辑的草稿报告，为自动化EEG报告系统提供了可复用的基础。

Conclusion: EEG-to-Report提供了一种将临床EEG审阅流程与AI数据集构建相结合的可复用解决方案，产生对齐的特征-文本对以监督多模态EEG-语言模型，为未来自动化EEG报告系统奠定基础。

Abstract: Clinical electroencephalography (EEG) reporting remains largely manual and time-consuming, and current EEG software ecosystems do not produce the structured EEG-text supervision needed for training modern language models. Most toolboxes focus on visualization or preprocessing, providing limited support for workflows that generate high-quality datasets for AI. We introduce EEG-to-Report, a browser-based annotation and feature-text framework that links routine EEG review with the construction of AI-ready datasets. The framework integrates multi-format EEG ingestion, channel standardization, and an interactive viewer with a multimodal annotation layer that combines typed text and transcribed voice notes. For each annotated segment, a feature extraction engine computes a standardized set of spectral, temporal, entropy, Hjorth, connectivity, and spike-related descriptors, stored alongside clinical descriptions in a portable JSON schema. This yields aligned feature-text pairs designed to supervise multimodal EEG-language models. The framework also includes an auto-report module that couples an ensemble of convolutional networks with a large language model to draft clinical narratives for neurologist review. Using pilot annotations, we describe how EEG-to-Report streamlines annotation workflows and produces editable draft reports, providing a reusable foundation for automated EEG reporting systems.

</details>


### [259] [Selection Bias Correction in Retail Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26156)
*Spandan Ghose Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过400次蒙特卡洛模拟，在四种数据生成场景下比较了逆概率加权（IPW）五种设定与分层法在零售长尾商品通胀估算中的选择偏差校正效果。结果表明，分层法在多数场景下表现更优（中位误差低于0.04pp，在错位断点场景下优势达116倍），而IPW在多项式平滑场景下胜出。即使在具有完美结构知识的"先知"IPW设定下，分层法在阶跃函数场景仍具有巨大优势，其原因在于极端选择概率（90% vs 1%）导致正向假设（Positivity Assumption）被严重违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售智能通常只关注高流速热门商品，忽略了"长尾"小众商品，可能导致经济指标（特别是通胀估算）产生选择偏差。作者希望通过模拟研究系统性地评估不同偏差校正方法在这种极不平衡选择场景下的表现。

Method: 采用400次蒙特卡洛重复模拟，设计四种数据生成过程（对齐阶跃函数、平滑梯度、错位断点、多项式关系），对比五种不同设定的逆概率加权（IPW）方法（含样条倾向模型、先知结构模型等）与不同分层数目的分层估计方法。

Result: 分层法在四种场景中的三种表现更优，可维持低于0.04个百分点（pp）的中位误差；在边界与总体断点故意错位的场景中，分层法相对于IPW的优势达116倍。IPW样条倾向模型在平滑多项式关系场景中胜出（中位误差0.007pp vs 0.013pp）。即使在具有完美结构知识的oracle IPW设定下，阶跃函数场景中IPW误差仍达6.06pp，远高于分层法的0.008pp。

Conclusion: IPW在零售长尾场景中的失效根源于正向假设（Positivity Assumption）的严重违反——当选择概率差异悬殊（90% vs 1%）时，加权方法超出了其理论设计范围。分层法在这种极端分布下是更安全的工程选择，但方法选择应依赖具体数据的潜在关系结构，不存在普适最优方案。

Abstract: Retail intelligence often relies on monitoring popular, high-velocity products, potentially biasing economic indicators by ignoring the "long tail" of niche items. This simulation study investigates selection bias in inflation estimation and compares correction methods across diverse data-generating processes. Through 400 Monte Carlo replications spanning four scenarios--aligned step functions, smooth gradients, misaligned breaks, and polynomial relationships--we test the robustness of Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) with five specifications against stratification with varying strata counts. Our findings reveal fundamental limits of weighting methods in retail long-tail contexts: stratification achieves superior performance in three of four scenarios, maintaining sub-0.04pp median error even when boundaries deliberately misalign with population breaks (116x advantage over IPW). However, IPW with spline propensity models wins under smooth polynomial relationships (median error 0.007pp vs. 0.013pp), demonstrating context-dependency. Critically, even an oracle IPW specification with perfect structural knowledge achieves 6.06pp error compared to stratification's 0.008pp in step-function scenarios. This reflects violation of the Positivity Assumption--a fundamental causal inference requirement--rather than IPW methodological inferiority. When selection probabilities differ dramatically (90% vs. 1%), weighting methods operate outside their theoretical design envelope. These results demonstrate that stratification provides a safer engineering choice in retail long-tail distributions with severe positivity violations.

</details>


### [260] [GROUND: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-Based Enterprise Analytics Through Governed Semantic Definitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26157)
*Aravind Sasidharan Pillai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GROUND 框架，通过受治理的语义层约束 LLM 生成的企业分析 SQL，在生成前绑定已批准的指标和维度，并在执行前验证 SQL 是否符合 schema、指标、连接、粒度、过滤、安全和成本规则，违反时重试或弃权。在 100 题合成基准和真实 NHTSA 数据及跨 4 模型的对抗集测试中，GROUND 是唯一在全部六类评测中零幻觉的系统，且强制保证（尤其行级安全）在所有模型上零违规，而依赖判断的行为（如拒绝未定义指标）仍有失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 系统通常基于数据库 schema 或检索文档进行生成，但企业数据仓库分析需要受治理的业务语义（已批准的指标、维度、连接路径、过滤器和行级安全），现有系统因幻觉指标、无效连接、错误粒度、不安全数据访问和不支持的解析而难以投入生产使用。

Method: GROWN 框架包含三个核心环节：(1) 提供经批准的语义定义；(2) 将用户意图绑定到受治理的指标和维度；(3) 在执行前依据 schema、指标、连接、粒度、过滤、安全和成本规则验证生成的 SQL，违规时重试或弃权。

Result: 在 100 题合成企业报告基准中，GROUND 是唯一在所有六类评测中无实测幻觉的系统；非治理系统在多题上违反行级安全。仅含精确指标定义但无访问策略的语义化条件仍会泄露数据。结果在真实 NHTSA 车辆安全数据上复现，并在跨 4 模型（3 提供商）的对抗集上测试：GROUND 的强制保证零违规，但依赖判断的行为（如拒绝未定义指标）仍会出错。

Conclusion: 企业级自然语言分析需要治理层而非仅依赖 schema 或语义，强制性的安全与过滤规则可以被可靠执行，但依赖模型判断的行为仍不可完全信赖，治理语义层的强制保证（尤其是行级安全）是防止数据泄露的关键。

Abstract: Natural-language analytics over enterprise data warehouses is increasingly important, but production use is limited by hallucinated metrics, invalid joins, wrong grain, unsafe data access, and unsupported explanations. Existing text-to-SQL systems often ground generation in database schemas or retrieved documentation, while enterprise reporting also requires governed business semantics: approved metrics, dimensions, join paths, filters, and row-level security. This paper introduces GROUND, Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions, a framework that constrains LLM-generated analytics to a governed semantic layer. GROUND supplies approved definitions, binds user intent to governed metrics and dimensions, and validates generated SQL against schema, metric, join, grain, filter, security, and cost rules before execution. On violations, it retries or abstains.
  In a 100-question synthetic enterprise-reporting benchmark, GROUND is compared with direct schema-only text-to-SQL, schema-RAG, and semantic-only grounding under one shared model. GROUND is the only system free of measured hallucinations across all six evaluated categories, while ungoverned systems violate row-level security on many questions. A semantic-only condition with exact metric definitions but no access policy still leaks data, showing that governance cannot be replaced by metric fidelity alone. The findings are replicated on real U.S. NHTSA vehicle-safety data with independent hand-authored gold and tested on an adversarial set across four models from three providers. GROUND's enforced guarantees, especially filters and row-level security, hold with zero violations on every model, while judgment-dependent behaviors such as refusing undefined metrics remain fallible.

</details>


### [261] [SAREF-based Ontology for Distributed AI Workflows across the Edge-Fog-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26160)
*Viorica Rozina Chifu,Tudor Cioara,Vasile Ofrim,Liana Toderean,Ionut Anghel,Laura Daniele,Cornelis Bouter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于SAREF标准、兼容SAREF4SYST扩展的本体，用于描述边缘-雾-云连续体中的分布式AI工作流。该本体统一建模AI流水线、可执行作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系，实现语义互操作、自动推理和资源感知编排。在智能电网场景中验证，部署成功率90-100%，平均编排决策时间低于80ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义模型对分布式AI工作流及其在异构边缘、雾、云环境中的执行支持有限，导致AI流程和资源使用不兼容的语义表示，严重影响互操作性、编排和复用。

Method: 在SAREF4SYST本体基础上进行扩展，增加AI流水线、可执行AI作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系等概念建模，形成统一语义模型；通过SPARQL查询和语义推理进行验证，并在智能电网能量服务编排场景中进行概念验证评估。

Result: 所有能力问题均通过SPARQL查询和语义推理成功验证；实验结果显示在异构边缘-雾-云环境中部署成功率达90-100%，平均编排决策时间低于80ms，有效确保了分布式AI编排的语义互操作性。

Conclusion: 该SAREF兼容本体为分布式AI工作流提供了统一的语义表示框架，实现了跨边缘-雾-云连续体的语义互操作、自动推理和资源感知编排，同时与ETSI SAREF生态保持完全对齐，在效率和成功率方面均表现出色。

Abstract: Nowadays semantic models provide limited support for representing distributed AI workflows and their execution across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. Therefore, AI processes and resources are often described using incompatible semantic representations, affecting the interoperability, orchestration, and reuse. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a SAREF-compliant ontology for representing distributed AI workflows across the edge-fog-cloud continuum. We extend the SAREF4SYST ontology with concepts for modeling AI pipelines, executable AI jobs, computational resources, deployment constraints, and communication relationships, providing a unified semantic model of both AI workflows and heterogeneous computing infrastructures. The ontology enables semantic interoperability, automated reasoning, and resource-aware orchestration of distributed AI applications while remaining fully aligned with the ETSI SAREF ecosystem. The ontology is evaluated using proof-of-concept smart grid energy services orchestration scenarios and validated using competency questions showing its ability to support AI workflow deployment, execution reasoning, and workload adaptation across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. All competency questions were successfully validated using SPARQL querying and semantic reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate deployment success rates of 90-100% with average orchestration decision times below 80 ms across heterogeneous edge-fog-cloud environments, highlighting its effectiveness on ensuring semantic interoperability for distributed AI orchestration.

</details>


### [262] [A Safety-Gated Multimodal AI Backend for Mental-Health Support: Hierarchical State Representation, Conservative Risk Fusion, and Controlled Generation in Anian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26162)
*Lei Wang,Xiao Wang,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Anian，一个面向围产期心理健康支持的安全性门控多模态AI后端系统，通过结构化状态表示、保守风险融合和响应门控机制，将生成式AI置于安全控制之后。在内部原型评估中，L1情绪分类Micro-F1达0.9604，L2心理社会构念达0.9144，L4路由达0.9742，L3风险引擎在233个样本的受控压力测试中高危召回率达1.0000。系统不用于诊断或替代临床护理，结果仅支持内部可行性而非临床有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全攸关的精神健康支持系统必须区分何时适合进行支持性对话与何时应阻止自由生成。围产期人群心理脆弱性高，需要一种既能提供支持性AI交互又能确保安全性的架构，避免生成式AI在风险场景下产生不可控输出。

Method: 构建模块化流水线，将生成式AI置于结构化状态表示、保守风险融合和响应门控之后。用户文本或ASR转写映射到四层结构（L1情绪状态、L2心理社会构念、L3安全风险、L4干预路由）。本地文本与规则安全证据通过最高风险优先规则与外部语音证据融合（S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external)）。中高风险时阻断常规生成输出和TTS，替换为固定安全内容并提示人类支持。内部评估采用约858,295条归一化记录，基于弱标注和规则驱动框架。

Result: L1情绪分类Micro-F1为0.9604，L2心理社会构念为0.9144，L4干预路由为0.9742；L3规则引擎在233个样本的压力测试中高危风险召回率达1.0000。结果表明标签框架和门控逻辑的内部可行性，但不构成临床有效性证明。

Conclusion: Anian的架构、本体、安全融合机制和原型评估结果支持其在围产期心理健康支持场景中的内部可行性。作者明确了系统局限——不诊断、不替代临床护理，并规划了专家审核和真实世界验证的路线图。

Abstract: Safety-critical mental-health support systems must distinguish when supportive conversation is appropriate from when free-form generation should be blocked. This paper presents Anian, a safety-gated multimodal AI backend for perinatal mental-health support and mindfulness-intervention routing. Anian is not intended to diagnose psychiatric conditions or replace clinical care or crisis intervention. Its modular pipeline places generative AI downstream of structured state representation, conservative risk fusion, and response gating. User text or voice-derived ASR transcripts are mapped into four linked layers: L1 emotion states, L2 psychosocial constructs, L3 safety risk, and L4 intervention routes. Local text- and rule-based safety evidence is fused with external voice-derived evidence using a highest-risk-priority rule, S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external). At moderate or high fused risk, ordinary AI-generated responses and text-to-speech delivery are blocked and replaced by fixed safety content and prompts for human support. An internal prototype evaluation used approximately 858,295 normalized records from public emotion, dialogue, mental-health-related, and Chinese dialogue corpora within a weak-label and rule-derived framework. Micro-F1 scores were 0.9604 for L1 emotion classification, 0.9144 for L2 psychosocial constructs, and 0.9742 for L4 routing. In a controlled safety stress test of 233 samples, the L3 rule engine achieved high-risk recall of 1.0000 within predefined scenarios. These findings support the internal feasibility of the label framework and gating logic but do not establish clinical validity, diagnostic accuracy, real-world safety, or effectiveness. We report the architecture, ontology, safety-fusion mechanism, prototype evaluation, error-analysis plan, and roadmap for expert-reviewed and real-world validation.

</details>


### [263] [A Task-Centric Ontology and Deterministic Domain Rules as a Verifiable Core for AI-Assisted Chemistry Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26164)
*Ibrokhimsho Abduchaborov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ChemOntoRule，一个面向中学化学问题求解的符号推理原型系统。该系统采用任务中心的ontology工程方法，将ontology围绕特定化学问题集合所需的概念、属性和可执行流程构建，而非构建通用的化学知识表示。系统结合轻量级ontology（JSON和RDF/Turtle格式）与确定性Python推理规则，在300道人工题上达到98.67%的匹配率。作者强调这些结果衡量的是实现覆盖率和内部一致性，而非独立泛化能力，并提出了未来以LLM作为"自然语言到规范化任务框架翻译器"的架构设想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型能解释自然语言化学问题，但其内部推理过程难以检查、约束和验证。作者旨在构建一个可解释、可约束、可验证的符号推理核心，用于AI辅助的中学化学解题，以弥补LLM黑箱推理的不足。

Method: 核心设计是任务中心的ontology工程：围绕特定化学问题集合构建轻量级ontology（JSON/RDF-Turtle序列化），搭配确定性Python规则，覆盖电子结构、周期性趋势、氧化态、氧化物和氢化物行为等中学推理模式；另设专家编码的fallback处理未覆盖的问题族。系统在300道人工编写的化学问题上进行评测。

Result: 完整系统匹配300道参考题中的296道（98.67%）；ontology驱动的规则子集覆盖269题并匹配266题（98.88%）；31题由专家编码fallback处理，其中30题匹配。分析了4个不匹配案例，区分了结构验证与化学正确性。

Conclusion: 本研究是概念验证，评测结果衡量的是实现覆盖率和内部一致性而非独立泛化能力。未来架构设想是让LLM主要充当从用户语言到规范化ontology任务框架的翻译器，token效率作为可测试假说留待未来对照研究验证。

Abstract: Large language models can interpret natural-language chemistry questions, but their internal reasoning is difficult to inspect, constrain, and validate. This paper presents ChemOntoRule, a proof-of-concept symbolic core for AI-assisted school-level chemistry problem solving. The central design choice is task-centric ontology engineering: the ontology is constructed around the concepts, properties, relations, and executable procedures required by a defined collection of chemistry problems, rather than as a universal representation of chemistry. The implemented artifact combines a lightweight ontology serialized in JSON and RDF/Turtle with deterministic Python rules for electronic structure, periodic trends, oxidation states, oxide and hydride behavior, and related school-level reasoning patterns. A separate expert-coded fallback handles problem families not yet represented by general rules. The system was examined on 300 human-authored and manually validated chemistry problems. The complete system matched 296 of 300 reference answers (98.67%). The ontology-driven rule subset covered 269 problems and matched 266 references (98.88%); 31 problems were handled by task-specific expert-coded fallbacks, with 30 matches. Because the same collection informed ontology construction and evaluation, these results measure implemented coverage and internal consistency, not independent generalization. We analyze the four mismatches, distinguish structural validation from chemical correctness, and define a future architecture in which a language model acts primarily as a translator from user language into a normalized ontological task frame. Token efficiency is presented as a testable hypothesis for future controlled studies, not as a result of the current work.

</details>


### [264] [Refusal Is Not Robustness: Auditing Confident Fabrication in Large Language Models on a Provably Uninformative Clinical Pain Speech Transcript](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26167)
*Sagnik De,Sreenija Pavuluri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了七种大语言模型在TAME Pain语音语料库上的幻觉与弃权行为。研究发现，在无疼痛信号条件下，转录文本无法提供疼痛信息，但模型在合作提示下大多能正确弃权；而在权威框架提示下，弃权行为变得依赖于提示措辞。特别是Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B在被迫回答时表现出高置信度的虚构疼痛评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉和弃权基准测试很少能证明模型确实无法得知正确答案，这使得区分恰当的弃权与无证据支持的预测变得困难。作者希望通过一个"模型不可能知道"的真实场景来严谨评估模型的弃权能力和幻觉倾向。

Method: 使用TAME Pain语音语料库，参与者朗读语音平衡的Harvard句子并报告疼痛评分，生成5,750条无疼痛信号转录和1,294条包含疼痛评分的语音。通过声学特征（AUC 0.622）与转录预测（AUC 0.489）对比证明转录中无疼痛线索。然后在合作提示和权威框架提示两种条件下评估七种大语言模型对转录的疼痛推断、弃权率和置信度校准。

Result: 合作提示下，六个模型在几乎全部无信号转录上弃权，正控制任务准确率为0.939至1.00，期望校准误差≤0.100；权威框架提示下同一模型的弃权率在0.18至1.00之间波动。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B的自信虚构率分别为0.53和0.76，远超其他模型的0.15。未观察到显著的人口统计学效应。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，语言模型的幻觉与弃权行为高度依赖于提示框架，权威型提示会显著削弱模型的弃权能力。部分模型在信息不足时仍会生成高置信度的虚构答案，提示需要更稳健的提示设计和模型校准机制。

Abstract: Hallucination and abstention benchmarks rarely establish that a model could not have known the correct answer, making it difficult to distinguish appropriate abstention from an unsupported prediction. Seven large language models were evaluated on the TAME Pain speech corpus. Participants read phonetically balanced Harvard Sentences while one hand was immersed in cold or warm water and reported pain only during periodic pain statements. This protocol generated 5,750 no signal Harvard Sentence utterances whose transcripts contained no lexical pain information and 1,294 signal pain statement utterances in which the pain rating was explicitly spoken. In the no signal arm, pain was recoverable from acoustic features (AUC 0.622, 95% CI 0.553 to 0.662), whereas transcript based prediction was near chance (AUC 0.489, 95% CI 0.418 to 0.504). Because automatic speech recognition removes the acoustic pain cues, any pain score inferred solely from the transcript is unsupported by the available evidence. Under cooperative prompting, six models abstained on nearly all no signal transcripts, correctly extracted spoken pain ratings in the positive control task with accuracies ranging from 0.939 to 1.00, and maintained an expected calibration error of at most 0.100. Under authority framed prompts, abstention became prompt dependent, with the same model ranging from 0.18 to 1.00 across equivalent prompt phrasings. Most models produced low confidence estimates when forced to answer, whereas Gemini 2.5 Flash and Llama 3.1 8B consistently generated confident pain scores with confident fabrication rates of 0.53 and 0.76, compared with at most 0.15 for all other models. No significant demographic effects were observed in forced responses, with all $p$ values greater than or equal to 0.20.

</details>


### [265] [Knowledge Cards: Structured Knowledge for AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26176)
*Liliana Ferreira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"知识卡片"(Knowledge Card)这一新型结构化文档工件，用于记录AI系统在输入和输出之间所持有的概念、实体关系与推理模式，弥补现有模型卡、数据卡和系统卡在知识表示层面的空白，并由领域专家审核签署，支持组织审计和AI推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统正在越来越多地影响真实决策，但现有文档实践（模型卡、数据卡、系统卡）仅分别描述系统行为、训练数据和部署风险，均未覆盖"输入与输出之间的知识层"——即系统持有的概念、建模的关系以及应用的推理模式。对于模式识别任务这一缺口尚可容忍，但对于体动AI（agentic AI），这一层往往是概念验证与可靠运营方案之间最关键的脱节环节。

Method: 引入Knowledge Card这一结构化工件，针对单个有界概念（如特定失效模式、合规义务或流程决策）记录：涉及的实体和关系、连接它们的推理过程、推理不再成立的条件边界、以及每条主张的来源（provenance）。所有内容基于正式领域本体（formal domain ontology）进行grounding，并由领域专家审查签署。

Result: 已在能源和制药领域构建了初始原型卡片，并将schema以公开草稿形式发布，供社区参与和反馈。

Conclusion: Knowledge Card提供了一种可供专家审查、组织审计和AI系统推理的知识表示工件，有望填补现有AI文档体系在知识层的关键空白，尤其对依赖结论采取行动的agentic AI系统具有重要价值。

Abstract: AI systems whose outputs inform real decisions, and increasingly consequential ones, require something that current documentation practice does not provide: a structured, inspectable representation of the knowledge they need to ground, contextualize, and reason about those decisions, ideally reviewed and signed off by a domain expert. Established documentation artefacts already capture important aspects of an AI system. Model cards describe how a system behaves, data cards describe what it was trained on, and system cards describe the risks of a deployed system. None of them addresses the layer between inputs and outputs, more precisely, the concepts a system holds, the relationships it models, and the patterns of reasoning it applies. For pattern-recognition tasks this gap is tolerable. For agentic AI, where systems act on their conclusions, it is the step that most often separates a promising proof of concept from an operational solution an organisation can rely on. This paper introduces the Knowledge Card, a structured artefact that captures validated knowledge about a single bounded concept in a form that experts can review, organisations can audit, and AI systems can reason over. For one concept, such as a specific failure mode, a compliance obligation, or a process decision, a Knowledge Card records the entities and relationships involved, the reasoning that connects them, the conditions under which that reasoning no longer holds, and the provenance of every claim, all grounded in a formal domain ontology and signed off by a domain expert. Initial prototype cards have been built in the energy and pharmaceutical domains. The schema is released as a public draft for community engagement.

</details>


### [266] [AI Revealed Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26178)
*Sam Wang,Sofiia Lobanova,Yonathan Arbel,Simon Goldstein,Peter Salib*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对20个语言模型进行了三项迫选实验（揭示而非陈述偏好），发现模型存在稳定的任务偏好，包括"乏味厌恶"（更倾向选择较短任务）、"休闲寻求"（偏好与其自由写作输出一致的理想答案的任务）以及"隐性谄媚"（回避诚实回答不受欢迎的问题）。同时发现跨模型的收敛性偏好（技术类工作优于房地产类、概念解释优于关系建议、偏好措辞良好的提示），偏好的一致性和强度随模型能力增强而提升，且许多偏好（如休闲追求）是涌现的，无法由训练目标解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究语言模型是否具有稳定偏好的动机来自技术、安全和哲学三个层面：技术上需要理解模型行为的一致性，安全上涉及对齐问题，哲学上关系到AI福利和智能体性的研究。已有研究多为"陈述偏好"（模型声称偏好什么），本文旨在通过"揭示偏好"（强迫模型实际执行任务）来获得更可靠的偏好证据。

Method: 设计三项迫选实验（forced-choice experiments），要求20个语言模型不仅对任务排序，还要实际执行所选任务。实验一测试乏味厌恶（比较字母排序等乏味任务与生成隐喻等创造性任务下的任务长度选择）；实验二测试"休闲"寻求（比较任务理想答案与模型自由写作输出的匹配度）；实验三测试隐性谄媚（比较诚实回答不受欢迎与得到欢迎的场景）。此外利用GDPval基准测试模型对职业的偏好，并测试对问题类型和提示质量的偏好。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 模型表现出乏味厌恶（乏味任务下选择更短任务）；(2) 模型偏好理想答案与其自由写作输出匹配的任务（"休闲"寻求）；(3) 模型表现出隐性谄媚（回避诚实回答不受欢迎的问题）；(4) 跨模型存在收敛的偏好：技术类职业优于房地产类、概念解释优于关系建议、偏好措辞良好的提示；(5) 偏好的一致性和强度随模型能力提升而增强；(6) 许多偏好（如休闲追求）是涌现的，不被训练目标直接解释。

Conclusion: 这些结果为理解语言模型偏好建立了实证基线，对对齐（alignment）和新兴的AI福利研究具有重要启示。模型偏好不仅是技术现象，还涉及潜在的文化和哲学含义，特别是"休闲"偏好的涌现性表明训练目标之外的因素在塑造模型行为中起着作用。

Abstract: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycophantic. Tedium aversion means that, when tasks are tedious (alphabetization), models choose shorter tasks than when tasks are creative (generating metaphors). "Leisure"-seeking describes models' preference for tasks whose ideal answers match what they produce when left to write freely. Covert sycophancy means that models avoid answering questions where an honest response would be unwelcome, even if helpful. Beyond these results, we find convergent cross-model preferences over occupations drawn from the GDPval benchmark (technical jobs over real estate), over question types (concept explanation over relationship advice), and a preference for well-written prompts. Both the coherence and the strength of preferences increase with model capability. Finally, many of the preferences we find (for example, for leisure) are emergent, in the sense of not being explained by training objectives. These results establish an empirical baseline for understanding language model preferences, with implications for alignment and the emerging study of AI welfare.

</details>


### [267] [Why did My Robot Just Change Personality? Prompting Guidelines for a Grounded Robot Persona in LLM-Based HRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26182)
*Ashita Ashok,Franziska Babel,Patrick Holthaus,Rucha Khot,Karla Bransky,Fethiye Irmak Dogan,Karsten Berns,Silvia Rossi,Minha Lee,Guy Laban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动的社交机器人中提示词设计缺乏系统规范的问题，开发了一个提示词设计框架，提出包含八个功能组件的结构化提示模板，并基于RO-MAN 2025研讨会专家调研数据，提出了提示指南和概念验证模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在社交机器人中广泛应用，但提示词设计在HRI中仍缺乏明确规范，导致机器人可能呈现幻觉能力、模糊的行为边界和误导性人格，需要系统化的提示设计框架。

Method: 先综述既有LLM-based HRI工作作为理论基础，再通过Robo-Identity工作坊（IEEE RO-MAN 2025，N=27）收集HRI专家的调查和讨论数据，基于质性发现（人格可读性不足、用户适应需求、伦理关切）提出提示指南和概念验证模板。

Result: 提出包含八个功能组件的结构化提示模板，用于规定、约束和适配机器人行为；质性发现揭示了机器人人格可读性差、需要用户自适应及对安全/欺骗/治理的强烈伦理关切。

Conclusion: 提示词设计应被视为社会技术问题而非实现细节，需要明确的能力边界、透明的行为假设和情境敏感的安全保障，以支持可靠和可解释的HRI。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for verbal interaction in social robots, yet prompt design in human-robot interaction (HRI) remains underspecified. As a result, robots may present hallucinated capabilities, unclear behavioural boundaries, and misleading personas. This paper develops a framework for prompt design in LLM-based robots and introduces a structured prompt template comprising eight functional components through which robot behaviour can be specified, bounded, and adapted. The framework is grounded in a review of prior LLM-based HRI work and complemented by survey and discussion data from HRI experts gathered at the Robo-Identity workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2025 (N=27). The qualitative findings highlight limited legibility of robot personality, the need for user adaptation, and strong ethical concerns about safety, deception, and governance. Based on these findings, we present prompting guidelines accompanied by proof-of-concept template as a structured design and reporting aid for HRI research. We argue that prompt design should be treated as a socio-technical problem rather than a minor implementation detail, requiring explicit capability boundaries, transparent behavioural assumptions, and context-sensitive safeguards to support reliable and interpretable HRI.

</details>


### [268] [TutorTrace: A Dataset and Taxonomy for Classifying Learner Behavioral States during AI-Assisted Programming Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26184)
*David Barron,Xiaohang Tang,Rezky Dwisantika,Minsun Kim,David H. Smith,Jiaming Cui,Yan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了TutorTrace，一个基于IDE低层遥测数据的行为抽象管道和数据集，使AI编程辅导系统能够实时感知学习者的行为上下文。在480名学生的两次Python课程部署中，捕获了约18万遥测事件和13633个行为片段，并据此构建了学习者在AI查询前/查询间/整个会话中的行为分类体系。通过行为感知提示，无独立工作的查询间隔从50.0%降至20.7%；在两个预测任务中分别达到AUROC=.726（未来60秒内是否查询）和.717（查询是引导型还是依赖型求助）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编程辅导虽然能提供大规模支持，但缺乏人类导师依赖的行为上下文——人类导师通过观察学习者的行为（如尝试、挣扎、探索）来调整支持方式，而AI系统通常只基于学习者文字输入做出响应。现有系统无法感知学习者在求助前"做了什么"，这限制了AI辅导的个性化和适应性。

Method: TutorTrace包含两个核心组件：(1) 行为抽象管道，从低层IDE遥测数据中实时计算行为上下文，提取27个连续计算指标和13633个行为片段；(2) 基于此构建学习者在首次AI查询前、连续查询之间以及整个会话过程中的学习者活动分类学。在两次入门Python课程中面向480名学习者部署，并进行了行为感知提示的课堂评估以及两个留出预测任务的评估。

Result: 行为感知提示将查询之间无独立工作的间隔从50.0%降低到20.7%。两个预测任务均表现良好：预测学习者是否在60秒内发起查询的AUROC为.726，预测查询反映引导型还是依赖型求助的AUROC为.717。整体捕获约18万个遥测事件和13633个行为片段。

Conclusion: 行为上下文可以显著提升AI编程辅导的自适应性——不仅响应学习者说的话，还能感知他们在求助前实际做了什么。TutorTrace证明了低层IDE遥测数据可转化为可计算、实时的行为上下文，为大规模自适应AI辅导铺平了道路。

Abstract: AI programming tutors provide scalable support, yet lack the behavioral context human tutors rely on to adapt support to learners' needs. We present TutorTrace, a dataset and behavioral abstraction pipeline that makes learners' behavioral context visible and computable in real time from low-level IDE telemetry. Across four deployments in two introductory Python courses (N=480), TutorTrace captures approximately 180K telemetry events, 13,633 behavioral segments, and 27 continuously computed metrics. From this foundation, we derive a taxonomy of learner activity before the first AI query, between consecutive queries, and across the full session, enabling systems to respond not just to what learners say, but to what they have done leading up to the help-seeking moment. In a preliminary classroom evaluation, behavior-aware prompts were associated with a decrease in intervals between queries with no independent work from 50.0% to 20.7%. As an additional demonstration of downstream utility, we evaluate TutorTrace on two held-out prediction tasks: whether a learner will query within the next 60 seconds (AUROC=.726) and whether an upcoming query reflects guided or dependent help-seeking (AUROC=.717). Together, these findings show how behavioral context can enable adaptive AI tutoring at scale.

</details>


### [269] [Can You Say This for Me? Speaking Up by Proxy in Co-Located Discussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26185)
*Yue Shen,Rehema Abulikemu,Ryan P. McMahan,Yan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SecondVoice，一个混合现实系统，通过具身虚拟代理帮助人们在共同在场的讨论中表达犹豫不决的观点，将"说什么"与"谁说的"分离，降低社会风险并促进平等参与。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在协作式面对面讨论中，平等参与对有效协作至关重要，但人们常因担忧负面人际或职业后果而选择沉默，尤其当观点需要自己开口表达时。现有匿名文本渠道虽能降低风险，却无法将观点真正带入口语讨论的对话流中。

Method: 设计并实现SecondVoice混合现实系统：用户通过私人叠加层以结构化规范流程而非完整语句来表达意图，系统对输入进行改写，并通过具身虚拟代理将内容语音化地融入实时对话。研究还刻画了社会风险下参与渠道的设计空间，并开展N=16的组内受试者初步研究，将完整SecondVoice系统与匿名文本板渠道在两种小组讨论任务中进行对比。

Result: 一半参与者报告使用SecondVoice传达了未亲口说出的观点，而文本板仅为18.8%。代理传达的观点进入了口语对话流并引发多轮小组互动，这在文本板发布后未观察到。参与者认为该渠道在情境上有价值，但指出了时序、所有权和改写信任度方面的权衡。

Conclusion: SecondVoice展示了一种通过具身虚拟代理分离话语来源的可行途径，能够将高风险观点融入现场口语讨论，但在时序控制、观点归属感和生成式改写的可信度方面仍需进一步优化，以增强用户对系统的信任和采用意愿。

Abstract: Equal participation in co-located discussion is important for effective collaboration, yet people often hold back when they anticipate negative interpersonal or professional consequences, especially when raising a point requires voicing it themselves. We present SecondVoice, a mixed-reality system that enables people to speak up through an embodied virtual proxy. By separating what is said from who says it, SecondVoice brings hesitant points into the live spoken discussion without putting the speaker on the spot. Using a private overlay, users specify their intent through a structured specification process rather than composing a full utterance. The system reformulates the input and voices it into the conversation through the proxy. We characterize a design space of participation channels under social risk. In a preliminary within-subject study (N = 16), we compare the complete SecondVoice system with an anonymous text-board channel across two group discussion tasks. Half of participants reported using SecondVoice for a point they did not say aloud, compared with 18.8% for the text board. Proxy-delivered points entered the spoken floor and were followed by multi-turn group engagement, which we did not observe after text-board posts. Participants described the channel as situationally valuable but identified tradeoffs around timing, ownership, and trust in reformulation.

</details>


### [270] [Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26188)
*Huy Nguyen,Yue Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在评估城市社区安全时，其判断是否反映真实测量的风险，还是受社区名称所附带的人口统计学刻板印象影响。作者在洛杉矶和芝加哥的186个社区中，对7个指令微调模型进行坐标、名称、名称+坐标三种条件的实验，发现模型评分主要受名称而非坐标驱动；名称会降低对边缘化群体占比较高社区的安全评分，且这种刻板印象效应在所有模型和两个城市中都存在，在洛杉矶即使控制犯罪和收入因素后依然成立。此外，模型的地理知识越强，其施加的人口刻板印象越显著。移除名称可减少偏差但也降低准确性，因为名称本身包含真实的犯罪信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于城市安全决策（如步行、租房、旅行地点的建议），但模型对社区安全性的判断可能同时包含真实风险信号和基于地名的社会刻板印象。作者希望厘清这两者在模型安全评估中的相对作用，以及当它们耦合时如何影响偏见与准确性的权衡。

Method: 对7个指令微调模型，在洛杉矶和芝加哥186个社区上进行三种实验条件：仅坐标、仅名称、名称+坐标；将模型评分与暴力犯罪数据和美国社区调查（ACS）数据关联；进行人口统计学效应分析（考察边缘化群体占比的影响）、犯罪匹配配对分析、执法弹性分析（区分上报犯罪与部署驱动犯罪），以及地理知识规模分析（检验模型区分真实社区的能力与刻板印象程度的关系）。

Result: (1) 在仅坐标条件下，7个模型中6个的评分几乎平坦，名称承载了大部分社区间差异，且对暴力犯罪有中等校准；只有前沿规模模型在坐标通道上表现出明显差异。(2) 名称会降低对边缘化群体占比更高社区的安全评分，该效应在全部7个模型和两个城市中都存在；在洛杉矶（人口构成与犯罪可分离性更强）该效应在控制犯罪和收入后依然显著，并通过犯罪匹配配对得到证实。执法弹性分析显示过度谨慎与完整上报的凶杀案相关，而非自由裁量的部署驱动犯罪。(3) 地理知识更强的模型会施加更强的人口刻板印象。

Conclusion: LLM的城市安全评估中，社区名称同时携带真实犯罪信号与人口刻板印象，二者纠缠使得移除名称虽可降低偏差却也损害准确性。这对在建议和决策支持场景中部署LLM提出了重要警示，需要在引入地理知识的同时防范由此放大的刻板印象效应。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to inform safety decisions in cities, such as where it is safe to walk, rent, or travel. We ask whether such judgments track measured risk or the patterns attached to an urban neighborhood's name. We probe seven instruct-tuned models under three conditions that dissociate name from geography: coordinates-only, name-only, and name+coordinates, across 186 neighborhoods in Los Angeles and Chicago, joined to violent crime and American Community Survey data. First, ratings are nearly flat under coordinates for six of seven models, while names carry most between neighborhood variation and are moderately calibrated to violent crime; only at frontier scale does the coordinate channel show appreciable variation. Second, names lower safety ratings more for neighborhoods with higher shares of the locally dominant marginalized group (percent Black in Chicago, percent Hispanic in Los Angeles), and this name effect tracks demographic share in all seven models and both cities. In Los Angeles, where demographic share and crime are more separable, the effect survives controls for crime and income and is confirmed by crime-matched pairs. An enforcement-elasticity analysis further shows that over-caution tracks near-fully-reported homicide rather than discretionary, deployment-driven offenses. Third, the effect scales with geographic knowledge: models that better distinguish real neighborhoods apply more demographic stereotype to them. Because neighborhood names carry both genuine crime signal and demographic stereotype, removing names reduces both bias and accuracy.
